name: 蘇莉芸
objective:
介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。
The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.
課程進度(1-16週):
First week: Overview of Chemistry
Second week: Chemical foundations 
Third week: The quantum world: Describe atoms in the microscopic scale 
Fourth week: The quantum world: 
Fifth week: The Chemical Bonds: Describe the way that atoms connect together
Sixth week: The Chemical Bonds: 
Seventh week: Molecular structures: Describe how atoms connect in 3D space 
Eighth week: Molecular structures: Ninth week: Mid-term exam
Tenth week: The States of Matter I: Gases (a group of atoms or molecules) 
Eleventh week: The States of Matter I: Gases 
Twelfth week: The States of Matter II: Liquids and Solids (a group of atoms or molecules)
Thirteenth week: The States of Matter II: Liquids and Solids Fourteenth week: First law of Thermodynamics and Thermochemistry (Describe the Energy stored in the matters)
Fifteenth week: First law of Thermodynamics and Thermochemistry 
Sixteenth week: Thermodynamics: The Second and Third Laws First law of Thermodynamics and Thermochemistry (Describe how Energy transfers)
Seventeenth week: Thermodynamics: The Second and Third Laws (Describe how Energy transfers)
Eighteenth week: Final exam

The schedule is dependent on the actual progress of the lesson.
